"""
Fixed version: Dual-expert RNA model with corrected GRUCell initialization.
The bug was in BiGRUBlock where nn.GRUCell() was called without the required 'features' argument.
This version contains the complete fixed implementation without importing from the buggy lineage file.
"""
from typing import Dict, Any
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random, lax
from jax.scipy.special import logsumexp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 256,
        'kernel_size': 7,
        'dropout_rate': 0.10,
        'aggregator': 'mean_lse_max',
        'tau': 0.25,
        'length_normalize_lse': True,
        'learn_tau': False,
        'gru_dim': 128,
    }

def _lse_pool(h, tau, length_normalize=True):
    # h: (batch, seq, hidden)
    L = h.shape[1]
    core = logsumexp(h / tau, axis=1)
    if length_normalize:
        core = core - jnp.log(jnp.array(L, dtype=h.dtype))
    return tau * core  # (batch, hidden)

class PoolingBlock(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float
    aggregator: str = "mean_lse_mix"
    tau: float = 0.25
    length_normalize_lse: bool = True
    learn_tau: bool = False

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, h, deterministic: bool = True):
        # h: (batch, seq, hidden)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        mean_pool = jnp.mean(h, axis=1)                    # (batch, hidden)
        # tau (fixed or learnable per-model)
        tau_val = self.tau
        if self.learn_tau:
            tau_raw = self.param('tau_raw', lambda rng, shp: jnp.array(self.tau), (1,))
            tau_val = jax.nn.softplus(tau_raw)[0] + 1e-3
        lse_pool = _lse_pool(h, tau_val, self.length_normalize_lse)  # (batch, hidden)
        max_pool = jnp.max(h, axis=1)                      # (batch, hidden)

        if self.aggregator == 'mean_lse_max':
            pooled = jnp.concatenate([mean_pool, lse_pool, max_pool], axis=-1)  # (batch, 3*hidden)
            # project back to hidden_dim to keep downstream dims stable
            pooled = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(pooled)
        elif self.aggregator == 'mean_lse_mix':
            w = self.param('mix_weights',
                           lambda rng, shp: jnp.array([0.5, 0.5], dtype=mean_pool.dtype), (2,))
            w = jax.nn.softmax(w)  # convex comb
            pooled = w[0] * mean_pool + w[1] * lse_pool     # (batch, hidden)
        elif self.aggregator == 'mean_lse_mix_cw':
            w_cw = self.param('mix_weights_cw',
                              lambda rng, shp: jnp.stack([jnp.full((self.hidden_dim,), 0.5),
                                                           jnp.full((self.hidden_dim,), 0.5)], axis=0),
                              (2, self.hidden_dim))
            w_cw = jax.nn.softmax(w_cw, axis=0)             # (2, hidden)
            pooled = w_cw[0] * mean_pool + w_cw[1] * lse_pool
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown aggregator: {self.aggregator}")
        return pooled  # (batch, hidden_dim)

class BiGRUBlock(nn.Module):
    gru_dim: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x: (batch, seq, 4) one-hot RNA
        # Small linear embed to GRU dim
        x_emb = nn.Dense(self.gru_dim)(x)  # (batch, seq, gru_dim)

        # GRU cells - FIXED: added features parameter
        f_cell = nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_dim)
        b_cell = nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_dim)

        # time-major
        x_tm = jnp.swapaxes(x_emb, 0, 1)          # (seq, batch, gru_dim)
        x_tm_rev = jnp.flip(x_tm, axis=0)

        h0_f = nn.GRUCell.initialize_carry(jax.random.PRNGKey(0), (x_emb.shape[0],), self.gru_dim)
        h0_b = nn.GRUCell.initialize_carry(jax.random.PRNGKey(1), (x_emb.shape[0],), self.gru_dim)

        def fwd(c, xt):
            c, _ = f_cell(c, xt)
            return c, c
        def bwd(c, xt):
            c, _ = b_cell(c, xt)
            return c, c

        hf, _ = lax.scan(fwd, h0_f, x_tm)        # (batch, gru_dim)
        hb, _ = lax.scan(bwd, h0_b, x_tm_rev)    # (batch, gru_dim)

        rep = jnp.concatenate([hf, hb], axis=-1) # (batch, 2*gru_dim)
        return rep

class DualExpertNet(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    task_type: str = "regression"
    hidden_dim: int = 256
    kernel_size: int = 7
    dropout_rate: float = 0.10
    aggregator: str = "mean_lse_mix"
    tau: float = 0.25
    length_normalize_lse: bool = True
    learn_tau: bool = False
    gru_dim: int = 128

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic: bool = True):
        # x: (batch, seq, 4)
        # Conv feature extractor
        h = nn.Conv(features=self.hidden_dim, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), padding="SAME")(x)
        h = jax.nn.silu(h)

        # Expert 1: pooling
        pool_rep = PoolingBlock(self.hidden_dim, self.dropout_rate,
                                self.aggregator, self.tau,
                                self.length_normalize_lse, self.learn_tau)(h, deterministic)

        # Expert 2: BiGRU
        rnn_rep = BiGRUBlock(self.gru_dim)(x)                     # (batch, 2*gru_dim)
        rnn_rep = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(rnn_rep)              # project to hidden_dim

        # Expert projections and fusion (average)
        pool_proj = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(pool_rep)
        rnn_proj  = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(rnn_rep)
        fused = 0.5 * (pool_proj + rnn_proj)                      # (batch, hidden_dim)

        # Head
        z = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(fused)
        z = jax.nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        z = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z)

        if self.task_type == "regression" and self.d_output == 1:
            return z.squeeze(-1)
        else:
            return z

class WrappedRNANetwork:
    def __init__(self, d_output=1, task_type="regression", hparams: Dict[str, Any] = None):
        h = hparams or {}
        self.network = DualExpertNet(
            d_output=d_output,
            task_type=task_type,
            hidden_dim=int(h.get('hidden_dim', 256)),
            kernel_size=int(h.get('kernel_size', 7)),
            dropout_rate=float(h.get('dropout_rate', 0.10)),
            aggregator=str(h.get('aggregator', 'mean_lse_mix')),
            tau=float(h.get('tau', 0.25)),
            length_normalize_lse=bool(h.get('length_normalize_lse', True)),
            learn_tau=bool(h.get('learn_tau', False)),
            gru_dim=int(h.get('gru_dim', 128)),
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                      dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def build_network(d_output, task_type, hparams):
    return WrappedRNANetwork(d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type, hparams=hparams)

def create_network(hparams):
    return build_network(hparams.get('d_output', 1), hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'), hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)

def complete(params, opt_state, trial_data):
    print(f"[Complete] {trial_data.get('dataset')} val_metric={trial_data.get('val_metric')}")

from typing import Dict, Any
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random, lax
from jax.scipy.special import logsumexp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():

        'learning_rate': 0.001,

        'dropout_rate': 0.10,

        'tau': 0.25,
        'length_normalize_lse': True,
        'learn_tau': False,
        'gru_dim': 128,

def _lse_pool(h, tau, length_normalize=True):
    # h: (batch, seq, hidden)
    L = h.shape[1]
    core = logsumexp(h / tau, axis=1)
    if length_normalize:
        core = core - jnp.log(jnp.array(L, dtype=h.dtype))
    return tau * core  # (batch, hidden)

class PoolingBlock(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float
    aggregator: str = "mean_lse_mix"
    tau: float = 0.25
    length_normalize_lse: bool = True
    learn_tau: bool = False

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, h, deterministic: bool = True):
        # h: (batch, seq, hidden)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        mean_pool = jnp.mean(h, axis=1)                    # (batch, hidden)
        # tau (fixed or learnable per-model)
        tau_val = self.tau
        if self.learn_tau:
            tau_raw = self.param('tau_raw', lambda rng, shp: jnp.array(self.tau), (1,))
            tau_val = jax.nn.softplus(tau_raw)[0] + 1e-3
        lse_pool = _lse_pool(h, tau_val, self.length_normalize_lse)  # (batch, hidden)
        max_pool = jnp.max(h, axis=1)                      # (batch, hidden)

        if self.aggregator == 'mean_lse_max':
            pooled = jnp.concatenate([mean_pool, lse_pool, max_pool], axis=-1)  # (batch, 3*hidden)
            # project back to hidden_dim to keep downstream dims stable
            pooled = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(pooled)
        elif self.aggregator == 'mean_lse_mix':
            w = self.param('mix_weights',
                           lambda rng, shp: jnp.array([0.5, 0.5], dtype=mean_pool.dtype), (2,))
            w = jax.nn.softmax(w)  # convex comb
            pooled = w[0] * mean_pool + w[1] * lse_pool     # (batch, hidden)
        elif self.aggregator == 'mean_lse_mix_cw':
            w_cw = self.param('mix_weights_cw',
                              lambda rng, shp: jnp.stack([jnp.full((self.hidden_dim,), 0.5),
                                                           jnp.full((self.hidden_dim,), 0.5)], axis=0),
                              (2, self.hidden_dim))
            w_cw = jax.nn.softmax(w_cw, axis=0)             # (2, hidden)
            pooled = w_cw[0] * mean_pool + w_cw[1] * lse_pool

        rep = jnp.concatenate([hf_final, hb_final], axis=-1)  # (batch, 2*gru_dim)
        return rep

    d_output: int
    task_type: str = "regression"
    hidden_dim: int = 256
    kernel_size: int = 7
    dropout_rate: float = 0.10
    aggregator: str = "mean_lse_mix"
    tau: float = 0.25
    length_normalize_lse: bool = True
    learn_tau: bool = False
    gru_dim: int = 128

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic: bool = True):
        # x: (batch, seq, 4)
        # Conv feature extractor
        h = nn.Conv(features=self.hidden_dim, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), padding="SAME")(x)
        h = jax.nn.silu(h)

        pool_rep = PoolingBlock(self.hidden_dim, self.dropout_rate,
                                self.aggregator, self.tau,
                                self.length_normalize_lse, self.learn_tau)(h, deterministic)

        # Expert 2: BiGRU
        rnn_rep = BiGRUBlock(self.gru_dim)(x)                     # (batch, 2*gru_dim)
        rnn_rep = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(rnn_rep)              # project to hidden_dim

        # Expert projections and fusion (average)
        pool_proj = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(pool_rep)
        rnn_proj  = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(rnn_rep)
        fused = 0.5 * (pool_proj + rnn_proj)                      # (batch, hidden_dim)

        # Head
        z = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(fused)
        z = jax.nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        z = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z)

        if self.task_type == "regression" and self.d_output == 1:
            return z.squeeze(-1)
        else:
